newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - June 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - June 13.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
PEOPLE'S DAILY
- Hong Kong people from all walks of life welcome President Jiang Zemin's attending of handover ceremony at midnight on June 30
- Li Ruihuan, chairman of Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, returns from visit to Portugal, Greece and Germany.
- Three-volume "Chronicle of Zhou Enlai's Life," covering 1949 to 1976, published by Central Literature Publishing House.
- Huludao zinc smelter profits soar to 121 million in January-April
XINHUA DAILY TELEGRAPH
- Chinese Vice Premier Zhu Rongji talks on consolidation and development of economy, improvement of macro-control mechanism and ways to solve problems in current economic operation.
BEIJING DAILY
- Police in eastern district of Beijing swear to ensure peace and safety during Hong Kong handover period
- Equipment for Hong Kong handover celebrations in Tiananmen Square has been designed
- Huge stage set up at Workers' Stadium to celebrate Hong Kong return on July 1
CHINA SECURITIES
- China plans to cut contract taxes on property market to boost growth
FINANCIAL NEWS
- Regulators punish banks, brokerages and listed firms for irregularities
- Shanghai and Shenzhen stock markets to close on June 30 and July 1
- Chen Qingtai, vice minister of State Economic and Trade Commission urges state firms to face competition in marketplace instead of asking for state support
INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS DAILY
- China's state trading companies close bloated overseas offices
MARKET DAILY
- China approves 18 Sino-foreign joint ventures in retail sector so far
CHINA CHEMICAL INDUSTRY NEWS
- China natural rubber prices seen to continue to fall and could fall below 11,000 yuan per tonne
CHINA DAILY
- Presence of top Chinese leaders at handover of Hong Kong on July 1 symbolises China's confidence in successful transfer, Foreign Ministry spokesman Cui Tiankai says
- China's educational administrators will improve work on ethical education in primary and middle schools, colleges and universities, to help foster China's future excellence
